verdict.rationale: Swell's features page says you can import or export products from CSV files, including product categories, which covers the core bulk import/export need. A backend API with official Node and PHP libraries and a products resource offers a programmatic route, but only one marketing line supports the CSV claim. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit workflow (e.g. update-by-CSV or batch API endpoints), detailed docs on the CSV format and field coverage including variants and inventory, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
